name: numbers_evolution_e2e
description: E2E tests for Numbers Evolution application

scripts.e2e:setup: MIX_ENV=test_e2e mix ecto.create && MIX_ENV=test_e2e mix ecto.migrate
scripts.e2e:test: npm run e2e:setup && echo 'Starting server in background...' && MIX_ENV=test_e2e mix phx.server & SERVER_PID=$! && sleep 5 && npm run cypress:run && kill $SERVER_PID || true
